list.name: the lease is published by rename, so it overwrites a holder
list.replace:
/\ IF lease = None
       THEN /\ lease' = tok[p]

list.name: every contender is elected, the marker is not exclusive
list.replace:
/\ IF MarkerAt(Name(chain[p])) = None
       THEN /\ markers' = WithMarker(Name(chain[p]), tok[p])
list.with:
/\ IF TRUE
       THEN /\ markers' = WithMarker(Name(chain[p]), tok[p])

list.name: the elected reclaimer unlinks without reading the lease again
list.code: workspaceFs.ts reclaimDeadLease: drop `=== deadRecord` before unlinkIfPresent(leasePath)
list.replace: Goto(p, IF lease = rec[p] THEN "electedUnlinkLease" ELSE AfterElection(p))

list.name: a contender unlinks the marker of a dead elector instead of passing it over (F1)
list.code: workspaceFs.ts reclaimDeadLease: unlinkIfPresent(marker) when judgeLease(elector) is 'reclaim'
list.replace:
THEN /\ chain' = [chain EXCEPT ![p] = Append(chain[p], mrec[p])]
            /\ Goto(p, "createMarker")
       ELSE /\ UNCHANGED chain
            /\ Goto(p, "waitLease")
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, markers, minter, minted, alive, crashes, tok, rec, mrec, done>>
list.with:
THEN /\ markers' = WithoutMarker(Name(chain[p]))
            /\ Goto(p, "createLease")
       ELSE /\ UNCHANGED markers
            /\ Goto(p, "waitLease")
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, chain, minter, minted, alive, crashes, tok, rec, mrec, done>>
